description: Block an IP after securenow_agent_verify_ip returned blockAllowed. The block covers only the apps the alert is about (and one environment when the IP was seen in one), expires after the org's default duration (ttlHours up to the policy maximum), passes the trusted / allowlist / protected gates again, and closes the Requires Human row as blocked with your report. The org policy may record it in shadow mode instead of applying it.

confirm.description: Required for write actions. Must be true.

decisionSummary.description: One or two sentences: why this IP is malicious, citing the decisive signals.

notificationId.description: Notification id of the Requires Human row. Omit when the IP is not a row of it.

reason.description: Short human-readable reason for the write action.

ttlHours.description: Optional block duration in hours; defaults to the org policy and is capped at its maximum.

verificationId.description: verificationId from securenow_agent_verify_ip for this IP (valid 30 minutes).

name: securenow_agent_block_ip
title: Block IP (Verified, Scoped, Expiring)
